description: One atomic text fact observed on a PDF page. Describes ONLY what was observed. NO semantic classification (no heading/caption/table/formula/flowchart/paragraph/evidence detection).
design_principles: Observations describe only 'what was observed' (raw facts).
No semantic classification at the observation layer.
Provenance preserved: source_type + source_index on every observation.
Independent of CandidateSpan / Frozen 730 Pool / Legacy Generator.
Fields that cannot be reliably obtained are null, never guessed.
secondary_source_layer: word (PyMuPDF 'words') — natural atomic, no font info

text.description: Observed text content (stripped of surrounding whitespace only).

bbox.description: [x0,y0,x1,y1] in PDF points; null if unavailable.

source_index.description: Index within the source layer's emission order on this page.

reading_order_hint.description: Monotonic hint for reading order within (page, source_type).

font_name.description: Font name (span/char layers only; null for word/line/block).

font_size.description: Font size in pt (span/char layers only).

line_index.description: Parent line index in dict (span/line/char only).
